sampled:
stare, is often not very welcoming when you want to talk to somebody in their own language. However, it does make for an interesting conversation.

I am of English origin and so am used to hearing the question, “Do you know how to speak English?” as a greeting, and sometimes, as a parting shot. I always reply with “No, but I am learning”. I am not so much interested in the question itself, but rather in the way people ask it. I get a thrill from the unexpected.

This is a small example of the difference between the English-speaking culture and the culture of the Francophones in France. On the one side is a culture of communication based on the English language. On the other side is a culture of communication based on French. The most obvious consequence of this is that when one person speaks English and the other person speaks French, the one who speaks English can often not understand the other person.

Voters would have to vote in both primaries, and would have to decide whether they want to vote in both. If they don't vote in both, they get a letter from the state saying they voted and are ineligible to vote in the second primary.
The first primary would still decide who the Republican and Democrat candidates would be though, and the second primary would decide whether those candidates make it on the general election ballot or not, as the general election would only happen in presidential years. Franklin police have arrested a gunman who fired at least three shots outside a home on Friday morning, but missed and went inside.

No one was hurt by the gunshots.

The resident ran inside the home and barricaded himself. Police responded to the home in the 400 block of Granville Road at 9:34 a.m.
